proof: Use the stored scalar graph filtration: M has (q,T)=(1,1), W_d has (d,d-1), and positive derivatives add q but not T.
At q=n, quotienting F_n by F_(n-1) sets all W and positive jets to zero. The remaining diagonal algebra is QQ[M]/(I_d, partial P/partial M).
Every active potential monomial has at least two basic invariant factors. Its gradient belongs to the ideal (I_d), so the diagonal algebra is exactly the nilpotent-cone ring.
The six basic SO12 invariants are a regular sequence on the 66-dimensional adjoint representation, including two distinct degree-six invariants.
All coefficients from the vacuum to the selected cutoff agree between the product/logarithmic-derivative expansion and the independent binomial expansion, and preserve both stored prefixes.
